summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Netflix-style video catalogue application. All backend APIs working perfectly (12/12 tests passed). Frontend functionality fully operational including login, registration, home page, catalogue with 17 videos, search/filter functionality, video detail pages, and logout. Authentication flow and protected routes working correctly.

design_issues.issue: Uses data-testid with video ID pattern instead of generic selector

passed_tests: Login page loads with glassmorphism card and gradient text
Email/password inputs with show/hide toggle functionality
Login with test@test.com/test123 works and redirects to home
Register page loads with all form fields (name, email, password, confirm password)
Home page loads with hero title, 7 stats cards, Explore Now button, user dropdown
Catalogue page loads with 17 videos, filters sidebar, search bar, sort dropdown
Search functionality works - filtering by video name
Filter functionality works - category filters show/hide relevant videos
Video card click navigates to video detail page
Video detail page shows video info, Open Video button, company logos section
Logout functionality works from user dropdown
Protected routes redirect to login when not authenticated
All 12 backend API endpoints working (auth, videos, metadata, seeding)
User registration and admin login functionality
CORS and cookie-based authentication working properly
